title: Detroit City Highlights Walking Tour Downtown Icons and Landmarks
includes: A Knowledgeable Local Professional Tour Guide
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the heart of Detroit on a 2-hour walking tour through downtown’s most iconic landmarks. Start at Campus Martius Park, the city’s vibrant gathering place, then see The Spirit of Detroit and the famous Joe Louis Monument. Admire the stunning Art Deco details of the Guardian Building before exploring historic Capitol Park and the beautifully restored Book Tower. Visit the Michigan Theater Building and learn about its fascinating transformation, then finish at Grand Circus Park, surrounded by Detroit’s historic theater and entertainment district. Along the way, hear engaging stories about Detroit’s architecture, history, culture, and remarkable revival.
